name: v_current_roster
definition:
CREATE   VIEW rpt.v_current_roster AS
SELECT ec.employee_id, ec.employee_number, ec.company_id, ec.is_home_company, ec.employee_status,
       ec.first_name, ec.preferred_name, ec.last_name,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ec.first_name))) = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ec.last_name)))
            THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ec.preferred_name)), ''), ec.first_name)
            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ec.preferred_name)), ''), ec.first_name), ' ', ec.last_name)
       END AS display_name,
       ec.org_level1 AS district, ec.org_level2 AS store,
       ec.job_code, jc.job_description,
       ec.date_in_job, ec.status_start_date, ec.original_hire_date, ec.last_hire_date,
       CASE WHEN ec.last_hire_date > CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_future_start,
       ec.full_or_part_time
FROM stage.employment_current ec
LEFT JOIN ref.job_codes jc ON jc.job_code = ec.job_code
WHERE ec.employee_status IN ('A', 'L');

name: v_data_quality
v_headcount_daily
definition:
CREATE   VIEW rpt.v_headcount_daily AS
SELECT snapshot_date, company_id, org_level1 AS district, org_level2 AS store,
       SUM(CASE WHEN employee_status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active,
       SUM(CASE WHEN employee_status = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_leave,
       SUM(CASE WHEN full_or_part_time = 'F' AND employee_status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_full_time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN full_or_part_time = 'P' AND employee_status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_part_time
FROM stage.employment_snapshot
GROUP BY snapshot_date, company_id, org_level1, org_level2;

name: v_sync_health
definition:
CREATE   VIEW rpt.v_sync_health AS
SELECT TOP (500) run_type, started_utc, finished_utc, status, employees_processed, events_built, ukg_calls, error_summary
FROM stage.sync_runs
ORDER BY started_utc DESC;

name: v_workforce_events
definition:
CREATE   VIEW rpt.v_workforce_events AS
SELECT e.event_id, e.employee_id, e.event_type, e.effective_date, e.entered_utc,
       DATEDIFF(day, e.effective_date, CAST(e.entered_utc AS date)) AS days_entered_after_effective,
       e.from_company, e.to_company, e.from_store, e.to_store, e.from_job, e.to_job,
       e.termination_category, e.counts_in_turnover, e.reason_code,
       rc.description AS reason_description,
       e.rule_applied, e.source_system_ids
FROM rpt.workforce_events e
LEFT JOIN ref.reason_codes rc ON rc.code_type = 'JobChange' AND rc.code = e.reason_code;
